---
title: "keystonefig"
output: html_document
---

Working through wrangling data and will then create new versions of the graphs.

loading data and needed packages
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)


keystone <- read.csv("FINALDATABASE.xlsx - Master Data.csv")

```
cleaning data 
```{r}
keystone_clean <- keystone %>%
  clean_names() %>% 
    filter(usable_if_no_why == "Yes") %>%
  mutate(
    ci = as.numeric(ci),
    species = as.factor(species),
    ecosystem_type = as.factor(ecosystem_type)
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ci), !is.na(species), !is.na(ecosystem_type))
```


```{r}
library(stringr)

keystone_clean <- keystone_clean %>%
  mutate(
    ecosystem_type = ecosystem_type %>%
      str_trim() %>%                 
      str_squish() %>%               
      str_to_lower()                
  )

keystone_clean <- keystone_clean %>%
  mutate(
    ecosystem_type = case_when(
      
      ecosystem_type == "desert" ~ "Desert",
      
      ecosystem_type == "freshwater lakes" ~ "Freshwater Lakes",
      
      ecosystem_type %in% c("lake", "lakes") ~ "Lakes",
      
      ecosystem_type == "riverine" ~ "River",
      
      ecosystem_type == "temperate" ~ "Temperate zone",
      
      ecosystem_type == "estuary" ~ "Estuary",
      
      TRUE ~ str_to_sentence(ecosystem_type)  # clean formatting for everything else
    )
  )

keystone_clean <- keystone_clean %>%
  mutate(
    species = species %>%
      str_trim() %>%
      str_replace_all("\\s+", " ")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    species = case_when(
      
      species == "Canis Lupus" ~ "Canis lupus",
      
      species %in% c("Pisaster ochraceous", "Pisaster ochraceus") ~ "Pisaster ochraceus",
      
      species == "Mustela erminia" ~ "Mustela erminea",
      
      species == "Perca fluvia" ~ "Perca fluviatilis",
      
      species == "Dipodomys" ~ "Dipodomys sp.",
      
      TRUE ~ species
    )
  )

```

```{r}
ggplot(keystone_clean, aes(x =  species, y = log(ci), color = ecosystem_type)) +  
  # if we have log(1) = 0 means --> anything that moves specifically away from 0 is a keystone. however keep the lines as a good indicator of what we are deffining as signifigant 
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", size = .5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -1, linetype = "dashed", size = .5) +
  labs( title = "Keystone Species Classification by Interaction Strength",
        x = "Species",
        y = "Community Importance (CI)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)

keystone_clean <- keystone_clean %>%
  mutate(ecosystem_type = fct_reorder(ecosystem_type, ci, .fun = median))

ggplot(keystone_clean, aes(x = ecosystem_type, y = ci, color = ecosystem_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8) +
  coord_flip() +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-75, 10)) +
  labs(
    title = "Community Importance (CI) Across Ecosystem Types",
    x = "Ecosystem Type",
    y = "Community Importance (CI)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

kruskal.test(ci ~ ecosystem_type, data = keystone_clean)

keystone_summary <- keystone_clean %>%
  mutate(keystone_flag = ci >= 1) %>%
  group_by(ecosystem_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    keystone_count = sum(keystone_flag, na.rm = TRUE),
    keystone_prop = keystone_count / n
  )

ggplot(keystone_summary, aes(x = ecosystem_type, y = keystone_prop)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of Keystone-Level Observations (CI ≥ 1)",
    x = "Ecosystem Type",
    y = "Proportion ≥ 1"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(forcats)

keystone_clean <- keystone_clean %>%
  mutate(ecosystem_type = fct_reorder(ecosystem_type, ci, .fun = median))

ggplot(keystone_clean, aes(x = ecosystem_type, y = ci, fill = ecosystem_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  coord_flip() +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-75, 10)) +
  labs(
    title = "Community Importance (CI) Across Ecosystem Types",
    x = "Ecosystem Type",
    y = "Community Importance (CI)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```
